summary: Full-stack audit run executed on public preview: backend public APIs/video-range/AI parse checks passed via pytest; frontend mobile-web login+privacy+tab navigation and key route openings passed partially, with significant coverage blockers from missing testIDs on many interactive controls and web Alert limitations.

minor.issue: Synthetic audio transcribe test skipped because no discoverable voice sample file was available from tested candidate names in this environment.

ui_bugs.component: Bottom tab and Altro menu controls
ui_bugs.issue: Multiple strict-selector collisions and role lookup timeouts in mobile web due absent/insufficient testID coverage on tab/menu touchables; automation required fragile text-last fallback.
Could not deterministically open first order detail in automation run; selector for order rows is not stable (no testID) and list opening behavior was ambiguous under mobile web automation.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably complete in web preview because logout path depends on React Native Alert.confirmation (known web no-op behavior) and no dedicated logout testID-driven fallback action was available.

issues: Console repeatedly reports deprecated web styling warnings (`shadow*`, `pointerEvents`) that are non-blocking but noisy during regression runs.

action_items: Add testID attributes to all tab-bar buttons, Altro list rows, Orders list cards, and order-detail entry points to enable deterministic mobile automation.
Add non-Alert web-compatible logout confirmation/test path (or testID hook) to validate logout/relogin persistence in preview.
Run focused financial regression on order detail totals: code review indicates IVA display/sum may be double-counted from `line_total` in `app/order/[id].tsx`.
Provide deterministic synthetic audio sample name (or fixture endpoint) for `/api/ai-tour/transcribe` regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: `frontend/app/order/[id].tsx` computes IVA as `(item.line_total * ivaRate/100)` and totals IVA similarly from line_total; if line_total already includes IVA, this overstates IVA in both row and summary.
`frontend/app/order/[id].tsx` summary labels `Subtotale prodotti` from sum(line_total), which appears gross/taxed rather than net subtotal naming used elsewhere; high risk of fiscal UI mismatch.
Large screen modules remain very long (`order-collection-v2.tsx` > 2400 lines), increasing regression risk despite current runtime pass.

success_rate.frontend: Core auth/privacy/tab+route smoke passed; deeper E2E coverage partial due selector/testability blockers

seed_data_creation: None. No intentional new production TEST entities were created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use existing credentials file; reuse `test_backend_audit_iter29.py`. For UI, prioritize adding testIDs before extending E2E to customer/order/calendar CRUD and logout persistence checks.
rca_of_issue: Primary blocker RCA: many interactive RN components (tabs, list cards, menu rows) lack stable testIDs, causing strict-selector collisions/timeouts in Playwright mobile-web. Secondary RCA: RN Alert-based confirmation flows (logout) are intentionally weak on web preview, preventing reliable auth lifecycle assertions there without alternate UI hooks.
